"""Collect post-build AMDGPU resources; never execute a kernel or claim speed."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import socket
import subprocess

from read_amdgpu_metadata_r1 import metadata

B = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
P = Path('<evidence-home-1>/projects/AIMA-public-r1191-candidate')
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest()


def resources(binary):
    result = {}
    fields = ('.name', '.symbol', '.vgpr_count', '.sgpr_count', '.vgpr_spill_count',
              '.sgpr_spill_count', '.group_segment_fixed_size',
              '.private_segment_fixed_size', '.wavefront_size',
              '.max_flat_workgroup_size', '.uses_dynamic_stack')
    for obj in metadata(binary):
        for kernel in obj['metadata'].get('amdhsa.kernels', []):
            name = kernel['.name']
            role = None
            if name.startswith('_ZN16qrt_fla_lifetime12state_kernelILj8EEE'):
                role = 'retained_state'
            elif 'qrt_fla_separate_state' in name and 'fast_kernelILj8EEE' in name:
                role = 'fast_state'
            elif 'qrt_fla_separate_state' in name and 'replay_kernelILj8EEE' in name:
                role = 'replay_state'
            elif 'qrt_fla_hybrid_state' in name and 'retry_kernelILj8EEE' in name:
                role = 'hybrid_retry_state'
            if role:
                assert role not in result, (role, 'duplicate kernel')
                result[role] = dict(elf_offset=obj['elf_offset'],
                    metadata={k: kernel[k] for k in fields if k in kernel})
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--inspect-retained', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.inspect_retained:
        info = read(B / 'retained-state-disassembly-r1/input.json')
        elf = B / 'retained-state-disassembly-r1/retained-state-code-object.elf'
        assert sha(elf) == info['elf_sha256']
        observed = resources(elf.read_bytes())
        assert set(observed) == {'retained_state'}
        assert observed['retained_state']['metadata']['.vgpr_count'] == 113
        assert observed['retained_state']['metadata']['.group_segment_fixed_size'] == 26180
        print(json.dumps(dict(scope='Local retained ELF parser check only', resources=observed), indent=2))
        return

    # No network or output directory is created until the finished native build
    # and its source/host evidence have been checked locally.
    plan_path = B / 'state-replay-provider-components-native-source-r1.json'
    plan = read(plan_path)
    build = B / 'state-replay-provider-components-build-r1'
    if not (build / 'run-record.json').is_file():
        raise SystemExit('The isolated native build has not completed; no remote action was attempted.')
    run, meta, dispatch, preflight = map(read, (build / 'run-record.json',
        build / 'build-provenance.json', build / 'dispatch.json', build / 'preflight.json'))
    assert run['host'].lower() == 'baiying' and run['reason'] == 'completed' and run['exit_code'] == 0
    assert run['host_checks_pass'] and all(run['host_checks'].values()) and not run['after_processes']
    assert dispatch['returncode'] == 0 and preflight['pass']
    assert meta['repo_commit'] == run['spec']['repo_commit'] == plan['source_commit']
    assert sha(build / 'run-record.json') == meta['run_record_sha256']
    assert meta['command_file_sha256'] == run['spec']['command_file_sha256'] == plan['script_sha256']
    assert sha(B / plan['script']) == plan['script_sha256']
    normalize = lambda x: x.replace('\\', '/').removeprefix(plan['repo'] + '/')
    sources = {normalize(x['file']): x['sha256'] for x in meta['source_inputs']}
    run_sources = {normalize(x['file']): x['sha256'] for x in run['spec']['source_inputs']}
    assert sources == run_sources == plan['source_sha256'] and len(sources) == plan['source_input_count']
    for name, digest in sources.items():
        payload = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', plan['source_commit'] + ':' + name], cwd=P, timeout=15)
        assert hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() == digest, name
    expected = meta['executable']
    assert normalize(expected['file']) == 'build/state-replay-provider-components/state-replay-provider-components.exe'
    assert meta['arguments'] == run['spec']['arguments']
    assert '--offload-arch=gfx1151' in meta['arguments'] and '-O2' in meta['arguments'] and '-include' in meta['arguments']
    output = B / 'state-replay-provider-components-resources-r1'
    assert not output.exists(), 'Preserve existing evidence; choose a new output revision'
    output.mkdir()
    exe = output / 'state-replay-provider-components.exe'
    assert socket.gethostname().split('.')[0].lower() != 'baiying'
    command = ['scp', '-o', 'BatchMode=yes', '-o', 'ConnectTimeout=10',
               'baiying:' + expected['file'].replace('\\', '/'), str(exe)]
    copied = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, errors='replace', timeout=60)
    with (output / 'download.json').open('x') as f:
        json.dump(dict(command=command, returncode=copied.returncode,
            stdout=copied.stdout, stderr=copied.stderr), f, indent=2)
        f.write('\n')
    copied.check_returncode()
    assert sha(exe) == expected['sha256'] and exe.stat().st_size == expected['bytes']
    kernels = resources(exe.read_bytes())
    assert set(kernels) == {'retained_state', 'fast_state', 'replay_state', 'hybrid_retry_state'}
    for kernel in kernels.values():
        assert kernel['metadata']['.wavefront_size'] == 32
    retained_path = B / 'retained-state-disassembly-r1/input.json'
    retained = read(retained_path)
    report = dict(kind='state_replay_provider_static_native_resources',
        utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(), source_commit=plan['source_commit'],
        host='baiying for compilation; local Mac for ELF inspection',
        model='none; static compiler resources only', command_file=plan['script'],
        plan_sha256=sha(plan_path), run_record_sha256=sha(build / 'run-record.json'),
        build_provenance_sha256=sha(build / 'build-provenance.json'),
        source_input_count=len(sources), executable=expected, kernels=kernels,
        retained_runtime=dict(file=str(retained_path.relative_to(B)), sha256=sha(retained_path),
            source_commit=retained['source_commit'], dll_sha256=retained['dll_sha256'],
            kernel=retained['kernel']),
        collector_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)), parser_sha256=sha(B / 'read_amdgpu_metadata_r1.py'),
        scope='Compiler metadata only. Same-executable retained, fast, hybrid retry and replay kernels are reported separately. Register counts alone do not establish occupancy, correctness or speed. Static resources do not qualify the default-off runtime integration.',
        inference_acceptance=False, performance_acceptance=False)
    with (output / 'analysis.json').open('x') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        f.write('\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(executable_sha256=expected['sha256'], kernels=kernels), indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
